title: Crash on start with Nouveau GPU drivers (Nvidia NVA8)
body:
### Tested versions

### System information

### Steps to reproduce

Change the drivers to Vulcan inside godot4.4.1 and then because you can then not open it you cannot change them back, and it will not work in Linux mint updated.
